description: Create a managed MySQL/MariaDB database for a gameserver (max 5 per server, free). It is ready when its status turns active (list_gameserver_databases). The password is not returned: the owner reads it in the dashboard. Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

serviceId.description: ID of the Gameserver: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_gameservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: create_gameserver_database
title: Create Game Server Database
